name: Loom
tagline: Weave a 3x3 grid of drafted cards; every row, column and diagonal is a poker thread.
core_loop: Each round a shared market of P+1 face-up cards is revealed; in clockwise order every player takes a turn of three decisions: draw one market card, announce whether they will weave that drawn card face-up or bury their hidden hand card face-down, then place the chosen card in an empty cell of their 3x3 weave.
win_condition: After 9 rounds every grid is full and all face-down cards are revealed; score the 8 threads (3 rows, 3 columns, 2 diagonals) as mini poker hands and the highest total wins.
